content_of_post_to_comment: an underutilized argument against the private use of political violence is: you’re probably not very good at it and liable to make things worse you think you’re john brown when in reality you’re gavrilo princip
comment: The competence problem is only half of it. Political violence also destroys feedback: once you’ve made yourself an enemy, you lose the ability to tell whether your actions are helping the people you claim to act for.
